description: Maintain an existing destination: rename it, replace the stream key after the platform rotated it (custom RTMP only — a connected YouTube channel has no key to set), and archive or restore it. Archiving hides a destination from the picker without deleting it; it is reversible with archived=false. A live stream keeps publishing with the key it started with, so restart the stream after rotating a key. Pass only the fields to change. NOT transactional: each change commits on its own, and on a failure the response lists which ones already applied.

archived.description: true archives the destination (reversible); false restores it.

rtmpKey.description: The new stream key, copied from the platform's own streaming settings after it rotated the old one. Custom RTMP destinations only. Stored encrypted and never shown again.

name: update_destination

applied.description: On a partial failure: the changes that DID commit.

error.description: On a partial failure: what did not apply.

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it
